plainTranslation:
This connection can make desire confusing.

Mars wants to act. Neptune wants to feel into the atmosphere first. Mars looks for a clear direction, but Neptune keeps dissolving the edges. Neptune senses something meaningful, but may not know whether it is intuition, fantasy, fear, or hope. The attraction can feel powerful precisely because it is unclear.

At first, the confusion may seem like depth. You may feel pulled past your usual caution. You may ignore the warning signs because the connection feels charged, spiritual, or impossible to reduce to ordinary logic. But the square makes it hard to tell whether you are responding to reality or to what you need reality to be.

The Neptune person may remember something differently, avoid clarity, or drift away from what was said. The Mars person may feel increasingly unstable, as though they are fighting to hold onto a version of events that keeps changing. Then Mars pushes harder, demands answers, or confronts directly, and suddenly Mars looks like the aggressive one while Neptune looks wounded or misunderstood.

That cycle can become addictive. Confusion, confrontation, reconnection, relief. Then the fog returns.

This aspect does not only create confusion between two people. It can create confusion inside each person. Mars may stop trusting its instincts. Neptune may stop knowing the difference between intuition and wishful thinking. That loss of self-trust is one of the hardest parts of this aspect.

Reality checks matter here. Keep a private record of what happened before the story shifts. Be careful with substances, secrecy, and situations that make it easier to avoid the truth. Do not let chemistry replace clarity.

If something feels off, slow down. The connection does not become more sacred because it is hard to understand.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
